english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when a person, skill, or thing becomes part of an activity, group, or environment.
Use this when something gradually becomes part of its surrounding setting, group, or substance.

examples.english: The new colleague quickly managed to integrate into our team.
examples.traditional: 新同事好快就融入咗我哋個團隊。

examples.english: They quickly merge into the team at their new company.
examples.traditional: 佢好快就融入新公司嘅團隊。
